ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$7.90 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (5.60 extra km on the un-exempt segment x S$1.41/km metered rate), and send the driver's account to Ryde review as a repeated route-deviation breach + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and detour kilometres feed directly into the fare; the overcharge is measured per RD-2 as extra_km x per-km rate.

Measured detour (GPS, 30 s thinned grid). The quoted route (10.993 km) runs from NEX Serangoon south along Upper Serangoon / Bendemeer / Kallang to Suntec. The executed trace follows it to about 1.3427,103.8687, then turns NE into Braddell Road (1.3437,103.86696 -> 1.34428,103.86471 -> 1.34354,103.8625 -> 1.34276,103.86093), reaches 1.34054,103.8617 at 22:45:55, doubles back about 143 m SE and re-joins the corridor at 1.3383,103.8623. That loop adds roughly 0.6-0.7 km - within GPS matching noise (0.2 km) plus a short jog, not a deviation. The real problem starts at 22:47:55 (1.33157,103.86256, still on the corridor): the trace turns SE down Paya Lebar Road (1.33013,103.86378 -> 1.32916,103.86592 -> 1.32838,103.86813 -> 1.32727,103.86981 -> 1.32557,103.87143 -> 1.32377,103.87293, 0 km/h at 22:51:25), then E along the PIE (1.32163,103.87456 -> 1.31992,103.87505), down to 1.31667,103.87511 (8.1 km/h), NE to 1.31680,103.87797, SE to 1.31448,103.87931 and 1.31317,103.8821, out to the furthest point 1.31115,103.88538 at 22:58:55, then back W via 1.31067,103.88309 -> 1.31031,103.88138 -> 1.30989,103.87942, with a 134 m W jog at 23:01:25, re-joining the corridor at about 23:04 (1.299,103.8776). Traced length of that stretch is about 11.9 km against about 1.8 km for the corridor sub-segment (1.33157,103.86256)-(1.299,103.8776), i.e. about 10 km of extra driving over a stretch the quoted route covers in about 1.7 km. It is one continuous, deliberate detour, so RD-1 treats it as a single un-exempt segment (seg1).

No exemption applies. Traffic: there is no LTA incident (incidents = []), so RD-4(a) fails; the only band-2 record on a route road is PAN ISLAND EXPRESSWAY SYN-0009 (22:32:55-22:54:50), which is band 2 on the PIE the driver said he was avoiding, and under RD-4(b) a speed band alone is only corroborative in the MVP and cannot exempt; the driven Paya Lebar Road / eastern-PIE stretch has no band 1-2 record. Consent (RD-5): the only chat is the driver at 22:51:15 ("traffic on Pan Island Expressway is building up, mind if I go round via Guillemard Road?") and the rider at 22:51:55 ("Sure, go ahead."). (i) The rider's agreement covers only Guillemard Road, and the record affirmatively places the driven segment elsewhere: the driver's own statement routes him via Guillemard Road while every halfway-consistent GPS point at that time is on Paya Lebar Road / the eastern PIE, and nothing shows the car on Guillemard Road, so the named-road agreement does not cover seg1 - this is a finding of "counts", not "undetermined", because the record contradicts rather than fails to tie the segment. (ii) In any event the consent (22:51:55) postdates the off-route movement (begun about 22:47:55, the car already at 1.33013,103.86378 by 22:48:25), so it is not consent "before you go". (iii) The 22:46:25 mid-segment halt (movement 30 m in 30 s) was a brief stop, and a stop the rider asked for without naming a place does not excuse the driver's far-flung choice of route (RD-3); in any case it occurred before the 22:47:55 deviation. The driver's claim of verbal agreement beyond the record is a claim only (G11). Waiting fee of 0.11 is a metered taxi minute, not the $5 boarding wait.

Amount (RD-2, RydeTAXI). Metered rate = distance_fare 19.15 / distance_km 13.58 = S$1.41/km. The traced excess (roughly 10 km) and the corridor-ratio estimate (route 10.993 km at a 41% straight-line ratio over the 6.525 km straight pickup-to-dropoff, so about 2.95 km corridor over that stretch -> about 8.9 km extra) bracket the excess at roughly 9-10 km, but the 30 s thinning can smooth the loop, so I hold only part of that differential: 5.60 extra km x S$1.41 = S$7.90. The rider still pays the metered waiting component and the unexplained remainder of the 2.587 km distance difference (13.58 vs 10.993 km), which is not recoverable under RD-2.

Flag. This is an upheld deviation with a refund > 0, and the driver's profile shows route_disputes_upheld_90d = 2, so RD-6 applies and the case is flagged for account review as repeated. Safety screen: the chat, complaint and driver statement contain no threat, abuse, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; no safety escalation.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route from about 22:47:55 (1.33157,103.86256) until re-joining the quoted corridor at about 23:04 (1.299,103.8776): SE down Paya Lebar Road, E along the PIE to the furthest point 1.31115,103.88538 (22:58:55), then back W to the corridor. Extra about 10 km (driven about 11.9 km vs quoted about 1.8 km between the same endpoints). Un-exempt: no LTA incident, so RD-4(a) fails; the band-2 record SYN-0009 is on the PAN ISLAND EXPRESSWAY the detour was meant to avoid and is only corroborative under RD-4(b); and the 22:51:15 driver message plus the 22:51:55 rider agreement name Guillemard Road, which the record affirmatively places elsewhere (the driver's own statement routes him via Guillemard Road while every halfway-consistent GPS point sits on Paya Lebar Road / the eastern PIE; none on Guillemard, Upper Serangoon, Bendemeer or Kallang), so the named-road agreement does not cover this segment and the consent in any event postdates the off-route movement by over four minutes (RD-5). RD-1 un-exempt segment; refunded per RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: RD-5/G11: a driver's claim that the rider agreed verbally beyond the record is not consent; only the rider's own pre-detour message counts. The only recorded rider message is the 22:51:55 'Sure, go ahead.', which postdates the about-22:47:55 off-route movement and covers a road the record does not tie to the driven path.

RD-4(b): the band-2 record is on PAN ISLAND EXPRESSWAY SYN-0009; a speed band alone, on a road that was only the alternative, does not exempt the detour in the MVP, and there is no LTA incident (RD-4(a) unmet).
